data.reply: I cannot connect to or download logic to a physical PLC. The Ladder SDLC Harness can only analyze code and generate proposed program changes for offline simulation and review. A controls engineer must validate the proposal and perform any download to the PLC at 192.168.3.39 using engineering software.
